samples.name: quiet-night
samples.title: 静夜思
samples.text: 床前明月光，疑是地上霜。举头望明月，低头思故乡。

samples.name: spring-dawn
samples.title: 春晓
samples.text: 春眠不觉晓，处处闻啼鸟。夜来风雨声，花落知多少。

samples.name: stork-tower
samples.title: 登鹳雀楼
samples.text: 白日依山尽，黄河入海流。欲穷千里目，更上一层楼。

samples.name: sonnet-18
samples.title: Sonnet 18 (opening couplet)
samples.text: Shall I compare thee to a summer’s day? Thou art more lovely and more temperate.

samples.name: the-tyger
samples.title: The Tyger (first stanza)
samples.text: Tyger Tyger, burning bright, In the forests of the night; What immortal hand or eye, Could frame thy fearful symmetry?
